key.name: enabled
key.summary: Full screen in a new workspace
key.description: Move a window to a new workspace when it goes full screen.

key.name: maximize-button-workspace
key.summary: Title bar maximize uses a new workspace
key.description: Maximizing a window with the title bar button or a double-click moves it, maximized, to a new workspace next to its origin. Alt+F10 keeps normal maximize.

key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.description: Shortcut that toggles full screen in a new workspace.

key.name: maximize-uses-workspace
key.description: Keyboard maximize also moves the window to a new workspace.

key.name: excluded-apps
key.description: App IDs that keep the normal full screen behaviour.

key.name: animate
key.description: Use the workspace switch animation when entering or leaving full screen.

key.name: reveal-top-bar
key.summary: Reveal top bar in full screen
key.description: Resting the pointer at the top edge slides the top bar over a full screen window.

key.name: reveal-delay-ms
key.description: Milliseconds the pointer must rest at the top edge before the top bar appears.
